about_the_game:
Welcome to Diceville, a strategic city-building game where every roll of the dice can change your fate!

Inspired by board games, Diceville combines the depth of card tactics with the unpredictability of dice rolls — all without the hassle of rules and scoring.

Construct unique buildings from your deck and activate them based on the results of the dice rolls. Some buildings bring you resources from the bank, others take them away from your opponents, and some offer powerful effects that can change the course of the game.

As the game progresses, upgrade your city hall to unlock new abilities and paths to victory. The first player to fully upgrade their city hall wins, but it will take careful planning, good timing, and a little luck.

Play with friends (locally or using Steam Remote Play Together) or challenge the AI in this dynamic digital version of a board game classic!

Features:

  • Dice-based mechanics with deep card strategy

  • Build and expand your city with unique structures

  • Turn-based gameplay — plan each move carefully

  • Upgrade your city hall to unlock powerful new abilities

  • Local multiplayer (2–4 players)

  • Steam Remote Play Together support

  • Six factions with unique abilities

  • AI opponents

  • Languages: English and Russian (more to come!)

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (2nd gen) or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 / Radeon R7 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (4th gen) or AMD Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 / Radeon RX 550 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: Build your city, roll the dice, and outplay your rivals in Diceville — a card-based strategy game inspired by tabletop classics. Trigger building effects, upgrade your city hall, and race to victory in a game of luck, planning, and clever combos.
